in_hebrew.name: Ferrick
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ferrick הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German 'Fariz' meaning 'man of Rudolph' or 'ferd' meaning 'journey'. In Old English, 'ric' meaning 'ruler' or 'power'. The name Ferrick could represent a powerful, fiery man who embarks on a journey or rules with strength and determination.
